headline: Local Wedding Planner Rebrands As 'Geopolitical Facilitator' After Coordinating Seating Chart For Regional Leaders
body:
Vikram Sethi, a professional wedding planner who successfully managed a chaotic three-day destination wedding in Udaipur last month, has officially pivoted his career to act as a global diplomatic mediator. Sethi claims that his experience navigating the delicate seating arrangements between disgruntled relatives and rival cousin-groups has prepared him to handle regional security pacts and multi-national peace treaties with far more efficiency than any state department.

“The transition was surprisingly seamless,” said Sethi, while organizing a complex web of color-coded stickies in his office that represent maritime borders. “When you’ve convinced a mother-in-law that her rival’s floral arrangement is ‘thematically distinct’ rather than ‘aggressively inferior,’ convincing two warring nuclear powers to share a regional security umbrella feels like a light Sunday afternoon brunch. It’s all about the mood lighting and making sure the refreshments are served at the exact right moment to prevent outbursts.”

Sethi’s new firm, 'Alliances & Occasions,' now offers bespoke diplomatic packages that include conflict resolution through the strategic deployment of snack platters and a proprietary 'Cooling-Off' lounge. His latest proposal involves replacing high-stakes intelligence briefings with a mandatory round of 'Antakshari' to ensure that all participating parties are sufficiently embarrassed by their own musical range to consider further aggression. 

International analysts remain cautious, though some have noted that Sethi’s insistence on a strict 'No-Conflict' dress code has already led to a surprising increase in diplomatic productivity. "He refused to let the ambassadors leave the table until they agreed on the dessert menu," noted one anonymous aide. "By the time the baklava arrived, the borders had been redrawn, and everyone was actually talking about their grandkids."
caption: From managing unruly uncles to redrawing international borders, meet the man bringing wedding-planning precision to the UN. Who knew peace was just a good seating chart away? #Geopolitics #WeddingPlanner #Diplomacy (satire)
igHook: Would you trust your country's security to someone who managed your chaotic cousin's wedding?
